headline: Executive order sets who would temporarily lead the Office of the National Cyber Director if the top officials cannot serve.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets an order of succession for the Office of the National Cyber Director, the White House office that advises the President on cybersecurity. A succession order typically lists which officials would act as director, and in what order, if the director's job is empty or the director cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so the specific positions named are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials in the Office of the National Cyber Director
who_it_affects.how: Certain officials may be named to temporarily take over the director's duties if the director is unavailable.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 3, 2025; no separate effective date was provided.
